messages:
eli: Heads-up — after the kube-proxy rollout to ap-sg-gpu last night we're seeing a spike in prometheus remote_write 504s and scrape_duration p95 jumping from 120ms -> 2.1s. grafana: https://grafana.internal/d/abcd/scrapes?orgId=1
infra-bot: deploy kube-proxy v1.23.5 -> v1.23.6 (rolled to ap-sg-gpu)
maria: seeing remote_write errors on ingest-proxy-2: "504 upstream read timeout" in logs, also kvcache TTL for pod prefix exploded, cache:miss rate up 40%
ash: can you paste the relabel config? suspect the new relabeller added "__meta_kubernetes_pod_label_instance" causing high cardinality
eli: sharing snippets:
```
remote_write:
  queue_config:
    max_shards: 200
    max_samples_per_send: 1000
relabel_configs:
  - source_labels: [__meta_kubernetes_pod_label_instance]
    regex: (.+)
    action: replace
    target_label: instance
```
eli: also logs from proxy pod:
`2026-03-19T22:03:01Z ingest-proxy-2 ERROR upstream read timeout after 30s for batch=512`
maria: hmm, that relabel will explode series if pods have unique instance per GPU. Try adding `action: keep` with regex filter or drop the label upstream
sre-oncall: alert fired: prometheus.remote_write.504_count > 50 in 5m, page sent :phone:
ash: mitigation plan: 1) revert relabeller in canary, 2) increase remote_write queue shards and reduce max_samples_per_send to lower batch size, 3) add relabel rule to drop instance label when pod has gpu_id
eli: I'll roll back canary now — giving 10m observation window
maria: +1, also tune scrape timeout from 30s -> 15s on heavy exporter endpoints
infra-bot: rollback completed for kube-proxy on ap-sg-gpu canary
eli: after rollback p95 down to 140ms and 504s -> 3 in 10m, still watching :eyes:
ash: follow-up: create runbook entry and add a grafana panel for kv_cache_hit_ratio per exporter, assign to @maria
maria: on it, will open PR for relabel tests in prometheus-operator config
eli: thanks all :thumbsup:
